title: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
key_sentences: This Agreement is made on 2 November 2026 between:
Nothing in this Agreement obliges either party to enter into any further agreement.
It shall disclose it only to those of its employees and advisers who need to know it for the Purpose and who are bound by obligations of confidence no less strict than these.
The obligations in clause 3 survive for five years after its termination.
No licence under any patent, copyright or other right is granted by this Agreement.
The courts of England have exclusive jurisdiction.
Signed by the authorised representatives of the parties on the date written above.

(2) Bluefen Marine Systems GmbH, a company registered in the commercial register of Hamburg under HRB 204517, whose office is at Kehrwieder 9, 20457 Hamburg (“Bluefen”).
(a) is or becomes publicly available other than through a breach of this Agreement;
(b) was lawfully in the possession of the Recipient before disclosure by the Discloser;
(c) is received from a third party who is not under any obligation of confidence; or
(d) is independently developed by the Recipient without use of the Discloser's information.
